blocks.text: ДО ЗАПИСИ. Открой https://www.skool.com/salesforce-automation-mastery-2005/classroom/eeba9845?md=7adda0621e404191ac8782c92bfc0c7b и специальную Agentforce Employee training org. Проверь prerequisite предыдущей главы. Записывай фактический Builder и реальные synthetic records. При отсутствии функции запиши схему и явно скажи, что live проверка не выполнена. ГОТОВЫЕ ВСТАВКИ: https://sam-portal-production.up.railway.app/animations/agentforce.mp4. Анимацию используй как отдельное пояснение; UI показывай реальным снимком.

Create an agent with two narrow areas of responsibility. An Employee Agent helps a user signed in to Salesforce. A subagent defines behavior for a particular task, and the Router selects the appropriate area. An action is a concrete operation available within it. Instructions explain when to choose the action and how to present its result. They do not replace data validation, permissions, or the unique constraint enforced by the booking Flow.

cues.label: 02 · Create the agent in the current Builder

blocks.text: App Launcher → Agentforce Studio → New Agent → Agentforce Employee Agent. Name: Northstar Sales Assistant. Developer Name: Northstar_Sales_Assistant. Select Let's Go. Describe it in Agent Definition as an internal salesperson assistant for demo test drives and support requests.

ПРИ ЗАПИСИ · Create the agent in the current Builder. Выполни этот шаг в учебной org по открытому уроку. Покажи конкретный input, изменяемую настройку или узел Flow и наблюдаемый output. На сборку поставь CameraCue на паузу ⌘⇧Space. Не снимай токены и auth-файлы. До изменения состояния сохрани before evidence, после — persisted record/trace. Если это подготовка permission/activation, используй только уже разрешённую учебную конфигурацию; доступ к чувствительным системам не расширяй ради съёмки.
Check the value on screen before moving to the next step. If the result differs from the lesson, stop here and investigate that difference.

Select + beside Subagents → Create new subagent. Name: Demo Test Drive Booking. Description: 'Helps an employee find demo slots for a specific model and create a Test Drive after confirmation.' Choose Create and Open. In Instructions describe model → catalog → selected slot → Contact ID → confirmation → Flow → verified result.

Create Demo Support Handoff. Description: 'Creates a Case when an employee requests human help.' In Instructions require a concise reason, use a Test Drive ID only from a successful result or verified input, request confirmation before Case creation, and report the returned CaseNumber. Explain that it is queued work rather than a live connection.

Model requests and human-help requests have distinct responsibilities. Ambiguous input leads to clarification. Two subagents are visible and the agent describes its purpose without inventing results.

A common mistake to avoid is this: Following legacy Role/Company field instructions that do not match this Employee template. Keep the record or trace that supports your conclusion before continuing.
